categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.rationale: Reminder text leads a quiet inline board title/count; the full-board message now reads as information instead of a disabled field. Sign-in has a clear title, provider group and email group. The populated error heading and Try Again now establish a useful order; header-edge fragments still interrupt reading.

categories.name: Spacing/grid
categories.rationale: Board controls align with the first text line and rows share consistent text/separator columns. Account disclosure text now follows the body-sized row rhythm and Delete Account aligns with the other row titles. Native large/medium sheets remain coherent, although long explanatory footers necessarily occupy considerable space.

categories.name: Typography scale
categories.rationale: System body, headline, subheadline and footnote styles form a coherent scale in default and XXXL captures. Account disclosure titles no longer resemble subordinate help. The raw error remains readable but technical, and Activity single-line truncation is less graceful than the main board wrapping.

categories.name: Dynamic Type
categories.rationale: Default and XXXL originals preserve board paragraph text, wrapping capacity copy, sign-in help and Account disclosure children. Status values stack when needed rather than collide. XXXL is extraExtraExtraLarge, not AX1–AX5; those larger layouts and the complete combined-settings keyboard matrix remain unobserved.

categories.name: Light contrast
categories.rationale: Board capacity is now black on white (21:1), guidance is materially stronger, and Account helper/footer samples are strong. A separate residual remains: native light sign-in and Account error text is RGB(255,56,60) on white, 3.5697:1, below the packet’s 4.5 target for small text. Disabled fixture controls are excluded from that finding.

categories.name: Dark contrast
categories.rationale: White board text, neutral composer boundaries, readable Account footers and the white native Apple control are well separated. Dark sign-in error ink reaches 6.1172:1 on black. The same semantic red on the actual dark Account row RGB(44,44,46) is only 4.0597:1 at default footnote size.

categories.name: Iconography
categories.rationale: SF Symbols remain recognizable and restrained; completion, reorder, keyboard dismissal and account access have distinct roles. The Apple button retains its official native rendering and visible white boundary. Account trash has a consistent 24pt column and 14pt gap; external arrows are appropriately quiet.

categories.name: Safe area / Dynamic Island
categories.rationale: Native originals leave the status area, Island and home-indicator region clear. Expanded Activity text has adequate side/corner margins; collapsed compact/minimal views are intentionally empty. The board clipping defect is at the content/header seam, not evidence of Island overlap.

categories.name: Scroll/pull-down / last row
categories.rationale: All four true-bottom variants show the complete final reminder ink above the capacity/composer, and geometry records support that observation. Nevertheless, default bottom-after-pull originals retain sharp fragments of the preceding row directly below the board header. Paired Reminders images instead soften content beneath navigation chrome.

categories.name: List rows
categories.rationale: Paragraphs remain flat, readable and separated without nested cards. Completion is confined to the circle; text-tap and completion-after states show deliberate behavior, while the grip remains separate. The 44pt circle/grip alignment is strong. Repeated full reminder labels across accessibility children merit spoken traversal verification.

categories.name: Empty states
categories.rationale: All Clear is a familiar native unavailable-content composition with a clear existing instruction. The setup guide is flat, readable, dismissible and restores after keyboard dismissal. Hiding it during composition removes the former partial-guide clipping without changing its wording.

categories.name: Composer ergonomics
categories.rationale: The composer is anchored consistently with a distinct neutral field and obvious send affordance when a draft exists. Done now remains available with nonempty text and dismissal/refocus retains the draft. Full-board copy is static and unboxed, wraps intrinsically and does not invite an impossible edit.

categories.name: Keyboard handling
categories.rationale: The eight normal-settings post-scroll cases visibly separate Done from the alternate sign-in action; recorded edge taps and 48pt Done geometry support the baseline interaction. Board nonempty dismissal/refocus is clear. The selected combined-settings settled viewport omits the alternate action, so that configuration has no complete clearance pass yet.

categories.name: Sheet presentation/detents
categories.rationale: Account opens/reopens large, keeps native medium available, and scrolls within both detents with a persistent Done action. Opaque grouped content reads cleanly in both appearances. Reminders Details is a useful chrome reference but differs in semantics and does not supply a matching medium-detent comparison.

categories.name: Navigation clarity
categories.rationale: The small board title/count, explicit Account destination and persistent sheet Done keep orientation simple. Sign-in’s alternate method is clearly worded and visually distinct from submission. Disclosure chevrons communicate local expansion; external arrows identify links. Live auth/account completion is outside this inert-fixture evidence.

categories.name: Touch targets
categories.rationale: Source declares 44pt completion, grip, account, dismiss and retry targets, with 48pt sign-in Done/alternate actions. Native geometry and edge-tap evidence support the measured cases, including nonempty composer dismissal and paragraph taps that do not complete reminders. This does not certify every physical reach or accessibility configuration.

categories.name: Haptics
categories.rationale: Source ties success/error sensory feedback to outcomes and uses selection feedback at drag start, which suits a quiet utility. No physical-device sensation was observed, so strength, timing, duplication and preference behavior remain provisional. Passing simulator tests cannot establish tactile quality.

categories.name: Animation/transitions
categories.rationale: Sampled native recordings show coherent keyboard dismissal/refocus, Account disclosure/scroll and Island expansion states. Board mutations use a short 0.2s animation and suppress it for Reduce Motion. Sampled recording frames cannot certify continuous smoothness, physical timing or every combined-settings transition.

categories.name: Loading states
categories.rationale: Board loading has an existing textual ProgressView label and sign-in loading preserves button dimensions while replacing content with a spinner. Source supplies an in-progress accessibility label and disables duplicate work. Native loading variants remain calm; real slow-network progression and spoken busy-state behavior were not observed.

categories.name: Error states
categories.rationale: Populated-board errors now retain a clear heading, full exact diagnostic, retry and dismiss controls above cached content. Account failure/recovery and reappearance fixtures are present, with exact-message announcement policies. Small red diagnostic text needs stronger contrast; platform-domain wording remains a presentation limitation pending the user’s copy decision.

categories.name: VoiceOver/labels
categories.rationale: Completion has full text, state, hint and a custom Complete action; reorder exposes position and Move up/down actions. Board, sign-in and Account deduplicate announcements without forcing focus. Source now covers Account failures, but actual speech/traversal is unobserved, including potential repeated paragraph labels across circle/text/grip children.

categories.name: iOS HIG consistency
categories.rationale: Native NavigationStack, grouped List, ContentUnavailableView, official Apple control, system text styles and sheet detents create a convincingly native utility. Flat board/sign-in sections respect the minimal taste. The custom collection-view header seam is the clearest remaining departure from the paired Apple presentation.

categories.name: Lock Screen / Live Activity
categories.rationale: Native Notification Center banners and unmodified expanded-Island frames show legible neutral text and accurate 10-line conservation: 5+5/4+6 on banners, 3+7/2+8 in the Island. XXXL Island text still truncates mid-word. Empty compact/minimal is intentional; true physical Lock Screen, arbitrary wallpapers and AX sizes remain uncertified.

categories.name: Sign-in/onboarding
categories.rationale: Enabled-style originals show clear Apple/Google hierarchy in both appearances, improved help text and unboxed form grouping. Inbox, password, loading and error states retain exact copy and wrap well. Safe fixtures are intentionally inert and legal controls disabled; they establish appearance, not live provider or callback completion.

categories.name: Settings/account
categories.rationale: Body-sized disclosure title, footnote children, aligned deletion row and stronger footers materially improve consistency. Expanded/lower/error/recovery states remain readable at XXXL and medium detent. Exact-message announcement policies close the previous source gap; red error ink and unobserved real Account operations remain qualifications.

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.rationale: Sampled recordings present stable settled states through typing, scrolling and expansion; no gross layout collapse is evident. The packet has zero scoped runtime warnings/invalid frames, but retains 9359 other log events. Empty metrics and encoded frame rates do not establish launch speed, frame pacing or physical performance feel.

categories.name: Delight
categories.rationale: Restraint is appropriate here: a calm empty state, deliberate completion circle and small reliable composer make the board pleasant without decorative UI. Nonempty Done and readable capacity guidance remove friction. The harsh header-edge fragment and small diagnostic contrast keep the finish below exceptional.

categories.name: Long text
categories.rationale: Long reminder paragraphs remain intact and the final row is fully readable at true bottom in light/dark XXXL originals. Capacity and Account guidance wrap instead of shrinking or truncating. The main board handles long text better than the constrained Activity Island, whose tail can cut a word.

categories.name: Reduced Motion / Transparency
categories.rationale: Source explicitly suppresses board animations and strengthens solid chrome for Reduce Motion/Transparency or increased contrast. Actual Settings toggles and selected app originals confirm real combined-on presentation, followed by restoration to Off. The selected keyboard viewport and missing full setting matrix prevent a complete interaction claim.

categories.name: Palette / minimalism
categories.rationale: The interface uses system black/white/gray with restrained action tint and semantic red for destructive/error states. There are no decorative red/orange panels or nested cards. Flat board guidance and full-capacity treatment fit the requested Apple-native/Cursor-like restraint while preserving branding and icon.

findings.screen: Board bottom after pull, light/dark default; populated-error bottom
findings.description: Sharp lower fragments of an earlier reminder sit against the bottom edge of the fixed header. The source sets the UIKit top edge to soft, but these actual captures show that the intended treatment is ineffective in this hierarchy. Final-row/composer geometry separately passes.
findings.fix: Preserve all row copy, controls and safe-area geometry. Make the collection viewport participate correctly in native navigation scroll-edge treatment, or apply one deliberate clipping/softening boundary at the content-header seam. Verify arbitrary scroll offsets rather than tuning one fixture. Keep the last row fully visible and avoid adding a decorative card.
findings.basis: observed native originals plus source-derived ineffective setting
findings.check: Add a native screenshot/ink regression around the header seam at several partial-row offsets after pull and at true bottom, in both appearances and default/XXXL. Retain all existing final-row geometry, Island clearance and 44pt assertions; run the complete existing iOS suite after any fix. Existing last-row checks passed and do not test this visual seam.

findings.screen: Sign-in error and Account error, default and XXXL
findings.description: Default footnote error text uses semantic red over the entire message. Solid native glyph ink RGB(255,56,60) on white is 3.56965696:1 in light Sign-in and Account. Dark Account RGB(255,66,69) on the actual dominant error-row background RGB(44,44,46) is 4.05969209:1. Both fall below the packet’s 4.5 normal-text target. Dark Sign-in on black is 6.11722010:1. Antialias edges and intentionally disabled controls were excluded.
findings.fix: Keep every message word, warning symbol and existing hierarchy. Use primary ink for the message and retain semantic red on the warning icon, or choose adaptive error-text ink that reaches at least 4.5:1 on each actual background. Do not darken all destructive decoration or alter product copy.
findings.basis: observed native raster; independently measured read-only during this review; source uses foregroundStyle(.red)
findings.check: Add native solid-glyph/background raster gates for sign-in and Account errors across light/dark default/XXXL and Increase Contrast, requiring >=4.5 for normal-sized message text. Preserve exact string, wrapping and all recovery controls. Run the complete existing iOS suite. Current helper/footer contrast checks do not cover red error labels.

findings.screen: Actual combined Reduce Motion/Reduce Transparency/Increase Contrast sign-in keyboard
findings.description: Done remains visible in the separate settled combined-settings capture, but the alternate action is below that viewport and absent from its visible snapshot. Sampled recording frames do show the alternate action at other positions and include the disclosed AutoFill menu. This is not proof of unreachable content or a diagnosed source defect; eight normal-settings cases separately pass.
findings.fix: Reproduce the selected combined-settings viewport with native settings, then scroll the lower form while maintaining focus. If persistent clearance fails, adjust existing scroll anchoring/layout timing to expose the same alternate action without reducing target size or changing wording. Restore all settings afterward. Do not change product source solely on the basis of this single image.
findings.confidence: high for observed viewport gap; low for any inferred source defect
findings.basis: observed selected screenshot and sampled recording; interaction completeness unobserved
findings.check: Run the same eight focus/post-scroll/Done/alternate edge-tap cases with the three actual settings On, both appearances and default/XXXL; capture frames and focused-field validity. Include lower-form scrolling and exact alternate target reachability. The optional selected-setting check remains pending; it does not invalidate passed normal-setting gates.

findings.screen: Expanded Activity Island at XXXL in both appearances
findings.description: The second visible reminder ends with sample not… rather than a complete word. The +8 more footer is legible and correct, and the text clears the rounded corners. This is constrained-surface reading polish, not lost overflow accounting.
findings.fix: Preserve source reminder text, existing +N more wording, branding and compact-empty policy. Prefer a word-aware presentation truncation that retains the full accessibility label, or test a two-line allocation for a visible reminder while recomputing the visible/hidden budget. Do not shrink the user’s text setting.
findings.confidence: high for visible truncation; medium for best layout tradeoff
findings.basis: observed native frames and source lineLimit(1)/tail truncation
findings.check: Capture native default/XXXL expanded Island with unequal long lines, emoji and CJK in both appearances. Verify no corner clipping and visible-count plus hidden-count conservation; retain payload/surface cap tests and run the complete existing iOS suite. No exact Apple Activity counterpart is available.

findings.description: The current heading and retry establish a much better hierarchy, but NSURLErrorDomain error -1009 remains prominent in the diagnostic paragraph. Raw wording is preserved as required, and no exact Apple error reference exists. This carries the remaining presentation part of SOL3-03, not a demand for unapproved copy replacement.
findings.fix: Keep the full raw message verbatim. If further refinement is desired before a copy decision, subordinate the technical parenthetical with neutral diagnostic typography while retaining the existing title and Try Again as primary. Avoid new labels, decorative panels and any unapproved replacement text.
findings.confidence: high for visible presentation; medium for benefit of further hierarchy work
findings.basis: observed native originals and source propagation of localizedDescription
findings.check: Assert exact complete diagnostic remains reachable in initial/populated light/dark default/XXXL errors, and retry/dismiss stay >=44pt with final-row clearance. Preserve announcement deduplication and run the complete existing iOS suite after changes.

findings.description: The completion button exposes the full reminder as its label, the adjacent Text remains a separate child in a contain group, and the reorder grip again includes the full reminder. This source structure may require repeated lengthy reading for one paragraph. Actual spoken traversal was not observed, so duplication impact is a risk rather than a certified runtime failure.
findings.fix: First listen to the actual traversal. If the paragraph is repeated needlessly, consolidate its reading semantics while retaining the complete reminder, Active/Completing state and existing Complete/Move up/Move down actions. Keep the circle’s separate 44pt visual/touch target and do not restore paragraph-tap completion.
findings.confidence: medium for source risk; unobserved spoken impact
findings.basis: source-derived only; native screenshots establish visual row context
findings.check: Inspect the native accessibility tree and perform spoken VoiceOver traversal on short/long default/XXXL rows. Verify one understandable reading sequence, independent completion and reorder actions, and predictable focus after mutation. Existing policy/action tests are supportive but do not certify speech.

evidence_gaps: Physical haptic strength/timing and physical performance feel were not observed; no launch/frame-time metrics exist. Encoded recording rates are not display rates.
Actual spoken VoiceOver, rotor/traversal and focus behavior are unobserved. Exact-message policy tests cannot certify speech.
AX1–AX5 native layouts remain absent; XXXL is extraExtraExtraLarge. Actual combined-settings evidence covers selected views only, with no complete keyboard interaction matrix.
True physical locked-screen Activity and arbitrary wallpaper/Always-On contrast remain unavailable. Notification Center is explicitly not a locked physical device.
Enabled sign-in and Account captures are inert/safe local fixtures. Live provider, callback, notification, sign-out, deletion, settings URL, refresh and server flows are not certified.

No Notes, exact Apple authentication, Activity, loading or error counterparts exist. Account uses Reminders Details with semantic/detent/paragraph differences. The 17 usable references are regular iPhone 17 Pro/iOS26.2, not Duo.

The seven recordings were sampled into in-memory frame sheets for state/transition review, not continuously timed playback or display-frame analysis. The combined-settings recording contains an AutoFill-menu segment; its settled replacement PNG is separate.
Zero scoped runtime warnings/invalid frames is not a globally clean log claim: 9359 other error/fault events and compiler/tool diagnostics are retained.
Twelve unit-rendered Activity rasters are separate evidence, not part of the 288 native-image count; contact sheets and reviewer video frame sheets are thumbnails, not native screenshots.
User-facing raw-error wording remains unchanged; a product-copy decision is pending. This review proposes no approved replacement wording.

r3_dispositions.disposition: Resolved in native originals and source: capacity is unboxed primary text at21:1; guidance is10.3684:1/light and11.4199:1/dark. No disabled-field appearance finding remains.

Source gap resolved: AccountView and BoardPersistenceSection each use exact-message deduplication with initial presentation, clear/re-present and changed-message behavior. Safe failure/recovery fixtures add visual coverage. Spoken delivery remains unobserved.

Partly resolved: populated errors now reuse Couldn’t Load Board and Try Again with stronger hierarchy and readable full raw text. Remaining raw diagnostic presentation is SOL4-05; no copy replacement is approved.

r3_dispositions.finding: Other R3 grader: dark Apple boundary/provider appearance
r3_dispositions.disposition: Resolved visually: white native Apple control is distinct on black; enabled-style Google appears active in the safe inert fixture. Callback and root guards preserve fixture safety; this is not live auth certification.

r3_dispositions.finding: Other R3 grader: help text/Done inset
r3_dispositions.disposition: Resolved in the normal matrix: primary help ink is clear; eight fewer padding points retain the48pt target and alternate-action clearance. I do not fault use of a native keyboard toolbar or require a decorative replacement.
Resolved: only the44pt circle completes; paragraph taps retain the row and reorder remains separate. Done is visible with a nonempty draft, and dismissal/refocus preserves it.

Resolved: disclosure label uses body scale, children use footnote, the24pt icon/14pt gap aligns deletion titles, and helper/footer native samples pass. Red error-message ink is a separate new residual in SOL4-02.
Open and observed again in round4. The soft UIKit flag is present but does not resolve the captured seam. Bottom-row visibility is independently resolved.
Native visible/hidden counts are conserved; intentionally empty compact/minimal is accepted. Mid-word Island truncation and physical/spoken evidence limits remain explicitly open.

validation.basis: Reviewed existing recorded results; this reviewer did not rerun app/build/test/device actions
validation.reviewer_score_status: optional informational; cannot be used as a programmatic prerequisite
